articles.title: Pinnacle Silver and Gold plans drilling at El Potrero after high-grade silver discoveries
articles.description: Pinnacle Silver and Gold CEO Robert Archer joined Steve Darling from Proactive to discuss plans for a diamond drilling program at the company’s EL Potrero project in Durango, Mexico, following the discovery of silver-gold-lead-zinc mineralization on the Maria Fernanda 2 (MF2) concession. Archer said the company is advancing permitting for the proposed drilling campaign, which is intended to investigate the extent and potential continuity of the polymetallic mineralization identified during earlier exploration work. While permitting progresses, Pinnacle plans to conduct detailed geological mapping and sampling on the northern El Potrero claim block. The work will follow up on the discovery of silver-rich veins that returned assay results of up to 1,159 grams per tonne silver, helping the company identify additional targets for exploration. Following extensive mapping and sampling at MF2, Pinnacle believes the polymetallic mineralization could represent an extension of the system associated with the nearby Topia Mine, located approximately four kilometres to the southwest. Archer explained that the mineralized veins at MF2 generally trend northeast to southwest, similar to the structures observed in the Topia district. This differs from the predominantly northwesterly orientation of the gold-silver veins found in the northern part of the Potrero property. The contrasting structural trends may indicate that the two mineralized systems formed during separate periods of hydrothermal activity. The company believes several geological features at MF2, including alteration patterns, vein textures and elevation, point to the possibility that significant mineralization has been preserved relatively close to surface. Exploration has identified a series of generally northeast-southwest-trending structures exposed intermittently across approximately 1,500 metres of strike length. These structures contain variable gold, silver, lead and zinc mineralization within veins and breccia. Pinnacle has also identified elevated mercury levels throughout the area. The company views this as supporting its interpretation that the MF2 mineralization may represent the upper levels of a mid-sulphidation epithermal vein system similar to that found in the Topia mining district. At Topia, mineralized horizons can extend for more than four kilometres along strike and typically occur below elevations of 1,900 metres above sea level. articles.title: Novo Resources targets high-grade gold at Tibooburra
articles.description: Novo Resources Corp general manager of exploration Rohan Williams talked with Proactive about the company’s upcoming 2,700-metre reverse circulation drilling program at the Tibooburra Gold Project in New South Wales and the formation of a 70:30 joint venture with Manhattan Gold Corporation Ltd. Drilling at the Clone prospect will follow up encouraging results from Novo Resources Corp’s 2025 campaign, including an intercept of 12 metres at 5.9 g/t gold from near surface. The company is aiming to track the shallow, high-grade mineralised system further to the north and test its down-plunge extensions. Williams also discussed the company’s 70% interest in the Tibooburra joint venture with Manhattan Gold Corporation Ltd. Novo will operate the joint venture, allowing it to apply the geological knowledge gained from its previous drilling and continue expanding its understanding of the project. Alongside the Clone drilling campaign, Novo is working to develop a broader pipeline of targets across Tibooburra, with additional drilling of regional prospects anticipated during 2027.
